analysis:
Integration of all 23 units. Production code changes are small. NemotronSuperServingPolicy.swift:369 raises maximumEncodedBodyBytes from 8 MiB to 40 MiB. NemotronSuperLocalImageBinding.swift adds Failure.bodyTooLarge and splits the encodedHeaderQuote guard. The oversize check still runs before any reservation, parse or decode, so it fails closed. NemotronSuperLocalImageHTTP.swift maps the new case to a fixed mediaTooLarge error with no prompt or media content. NemotronSuperRequestPlan.swift and NemotronSuperLocalOutput.swift now allow a JSON response_format together with tools. Tool-call validation (ToolConstraintValidation) and forced-choice handling still run. Only call-free answers are validated as JSON, and invalid JSON returns 422. This is an API-semantics relaxation with no confidentiality, auth or attestation impact. Everything else is docs, changelog and tests. Those consistently describe a larger media charge (4.67 GiB per image, 4.54 GiB per video) and a slightly smaller default prefix bank.

I considered the earlier low finding on the media memory charge (unit 13) and discarded it. The increase is modest (3.62 to 4.67 GiB per image) and the change is documented. Admission still goes through the shared budget, which returns 503 when it cannot hold the charge. The ingress quote is about 1.28 GiB, bounded by the one-media-request-per-owner lock and the 32 MiB transport caps. Together these show a documented capacity trade-off, not a regression of a threat-model control (TB-007, T-010, T-029). T-041 prefix-cache scoping, TTL, HMAC naming and the encryption, attestation, key custody and authorization paths (TB-002, TB-011) are untouched. The smaller default prefix bank only reduces in-memory cache footprint.

Unverified contracts, which are coverage limits rather than findings: the memory-gate behavior under concurrent text load at the larger ingress quote; that the 32 MiB transport caps (localInferenceMaxUploadBytes, CoordinatorClient.maxInboundMessageBytes) are enforced before buffering; and that callers map bodyTooLarge consistently. The T-050 handling of inline video temp files was not shown changing.
